title: Unit component of normalized vector purity as the adjunct of integration
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N a positive integer annihilating A, B a Noetherian scheme with N invertible in its global sections, and F a rank-d locally free module. Let pi:E(F) to B have a compactification, W=pi* of the ordered coefficient A_B(d)[2d] [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], and gamma:pi*(-) followed by W tensor (-) to the Brown exceptional inverse image Rpi^!(-) be a family satisfying VectorPurityGammaNormalized [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization]. Then the inverse right unitor of W, followed by W tensor the inverse ordinary pullback-unit comparison and gamma at the tensor unit, equals the Brown adjunct of the specified vectorBundleIntegration [def-amb-vector-integration] followed by singleFunctorObjUnitIso. Invertibility of gamma is not required.

theorem vector_normalized_unit_adjunct
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (B : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian B] (hB : IsUnit (N : Γ(B, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (F : B.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    [HasCompactification (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)]
    (γ : VectorPurityGamma A N hA B d F)
    (hn : VectorPurityGammaNormalized A N hN hA B hB d F γ) :
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).2.1
    let π := VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F
    let W := Etale.vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA B d F
    let adj := Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) π
    ((ρ_ W).inv ≫ W ◁ (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) π).inv) ≫
        γ.app (𝟙_ _) =
      adj.homEquiv W (𝟙_ _) (Etale.vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA B hB d F ≫
        (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) B).hom)
